fields.q: 我知道我回不去了……可是……有时还是忍不住怀念失去的一切……
fields.en: I know I can't return home… But… sometimes I can't help but pine for what's gone…
fields.name: 乌修拉

q.value: 我知道我回不去了……可是……有时还是忍不住怀念失去的一切……

en.value: I know I can't return home… But… sometimes I can't help but pine for what's gone…

fields.q: 在故乡，我过着东躲西藏的生活……可在鞑古扎，我能做自己。你喜欢这里吗？
fields.en: In my homeland, I lived a life of hiding… But in Dagda, I'm free to be myself. Do you like it here?
fields.name: 乌修拉

q.value: 在故乡，我过着东躲西藏的生活……可在鞑古扎，我能做自己。你喜欢这里吗？

en.value: In my homeland, I lived a life of hiding… But in Dagda, I'm free to be myself. Do you like it here?

fields.q: 我受不了乱糟糟的桌子。只要有一点点乱，我就忍不住想收拾。
fields.en: I can't stand a messy desk. If it's just a little bit out of sorts, I get an overwhelming urge to clean it.
fields.name: 乌修拉

q.value: 我受不了乱糟糟的桌子。只要有一点点乱，我就忍不住想收拾。

en.value: I can't stand a messy desk. If it's just a little bit out of sorts, I get an overwhelming urge to clean it.

fields.q: 你看起来比一般的鸟聪明多了。要不要来商会当宠物？
fields.en: You seem far sharper than the average bird. How would you like to be a pet at the company?
fields.name: 乌修拉

q.value: 你看起来比一般的鸟聪明多了。要不要来商会当宠物？

en.value: You seem far sharper than the average bird. How would you like to be a pet at the company?

fields.q: 说实话，我有时会对自己的嫉妒心感到很烦。真希望能控制得更好……
fields.en: To be honest, sometimes I get so annoyed at my own jealous feelings. I wish I could control them better…
fields.name: 乌修拉

q.value: 说实话，我有时会对自己的嫉妒心感到很烦。真希望能控制得更好……

en.value: To be honest, sometimes I get so annoyed at my own jealous feelings. I wish I could control them better…

fields.q: 你的羽毛真是太美了。也许哪天我能为你画一幅肖像。
fields.en: Your feathers are simply gorgeous. Perhaps, one day, I can draw your portrait.
fields.name: 乌修拉

q.value: 你的羽毛真是太美了。也许哪天我能为你画一幅肖像。

en.value: Your feathers are simply gorgeous. Perhaps, one day, I can draw your portrait.

fields.q: 喂……要是你看到我变成野兽，记住千万别靠近我，好吗？
fields.en: Hey… If you ever see me become a beast, remember that you mustn't approach me, alright?
fields.name: 乌修拉

q.value: 喂……要是你看到我变成野兽，记住千万别靠近我，好吗？

en.value: Hey… If you ever see me become a beast, remember that you mustn't approach me, alright?

fields.q: 我没法像读其他动物那样读出你的想法……你真的是鸟吗？
fields.en: I can't read your thoughts like other animals… Are you really a bird?
fields.name: 乌修拉

q.value: 我没法像读其他动物那样读出你的想法……你真的是鸟吗？

en.value: I can't read your thoughts like other animals… Are you really a bird?

fields.q: 那时我因为纹章被人追杀，心想要是我是只鸟，也许就能飞走了。
fields.en: Back then, when I was being hunted for my crest, I thought if I was a bird, maybe I could just fly away.
fields.name: 乌修拉

q.value: 那时我因为纹章被人追杀，心想要是我是只鸟，也许就能飞走了。

en.value: Back then, when I was being hunted for my crest, I thought if I was a bird, maybe I could just fly away.

fields.q: 谭利穆恩在很多方面都救过我。陪他胡闹只是小小的代价。
fields.en: Talimun has saved me in far more ways than one. Attending his misadventures is a small price to pay.
fields.name: 乌修拉

q.value: 谭利穆恩在很多方面都救过我。陪他胡闹只是小小的代价。
